Q01.summary: Recursively collects glob patterns for non-excluded subdirectories (skipping excluded dirs and looping symlinks) under base_dir and returns all regular files matching them.

Q02.summary: Re-reads the watched file's size, pushing the deadline forward if it grew, and reports whether the clock has passed the current deadline.

Q03.summary: Prints a header for the ledger's accepted mutants, lists them grouped by kind with statuses and reasons, then prints advice about unevaluated and prunable entries, returning 0.

Q04.summary: Unless the status is allowed, raises the Faraday exception matching the response status (custom client errors, 407, 4xx, 5xx, nil) with response (and optionally request) details.

Q05.summary: Raises if the stack is frozen, resolves the index (integer or existing handler), and inserts a new Handler built from the args at that position.

Q06.summary: Returns true if any other fragment in the same file spans this fragment's start line through its end line (extended to heredoc closings).

Q07.summary: In a transaction creates the organization with invited memberships and owner, moves selected gems into it, marks onboarding completed, removes/demotes ownerships and emails members; records failure status on DB errors.

Q08.summary: For a newly created record that needs verification enqueues a verify job; otherwise for https links with failures newer than the last verification resets the failure counter.

Q09.summary: Maps a token to a mutant id: ordinal strings become integers, otherwise looks up the key, then a unique key matching ignoring line number, else returns the text.

Q10.summary: Builds per-scope dependency lists with resolved matching version slugs, then renders JSON partials or HTML with reverse dependencies and breadcrumbs, setting cache headers.

Q11.summary: Returns a truncated SHA256 of the type plus non-node field values of every node walked from the given nodes, i.e. a structural fingerprint.

Q12.summary: Walks the syntax tree collecting constant references (and association-name strings) with their segments, line, lexical nesting and enclosing scope, tracking class/module nesting.

Q13.summary: Returns an identity set of the seeds plus all nodes reachable by recursively following slot children and the last statement of statement lists.

Q14.summary: Returns 'name-version' by looking up the name and nested version.version scalar values in the YAML gemspec tree.

Q15.summary: Computes alias links from definition names to packages (via superclass, mixin-only modules, suffix-stripped names, and plurals), resolves each to its final target, and lists from/to/via for those that change.

Q16.summary: Scores an unless node with nesting-based cost, visits its predicate and body, then scores any elsif/else continuation chain.

Q17.summary: Flags File.open(name, mode) followed by .read (or block/&:read) and autocorrects it to File.read or File.binread depending on binary mode.

Q18.summary: Clears the hash and copies all pairs from other in, stringifying keys.

Q19.summary: For an if node, checks the keyword/else/then/end locations for missing spaces before/after and registers autocorrectable offenses.

Q20.summary: Parses options, runs a set of environment/config diagnostics (config, framework, sources, tests, git, rails, coverage floor, suite loading/baselines), prints them and returns 1 if any failed.

Q21.summary: Parses source, normalizes numbered params, applies the directive's handler operation, and unparses it, returning nil on any error.

Q22.summary: Sets surrogate key and cache headers, and if stale renders the compact index info for the gem with digest/ETag headers and byte-range support.

Q23.summary: If metadata storage exists and the key's file is present (within base dir), returns the parsed metadata JSON with symbol keys, or a default on read/parse errors.

Q24.summary: Creates a new registry for the configured operators and root and fills it with the mutation points found in the given source file.

Q25.summary: Returns a hash of status, body, headers and url, using nil/empty defaults when the response has no env yet.

Q26.summary: Logs the response status, and optionally the filtered response headers and body, at the configured log level.

Q27.summary: When the content type matches and the body is a string, parses the JSON body (optionally keeping raw body), wrapping errors in ParsingError.

Q28.summary: Returns the registered middleware for key, lazily resolving constant names or procs under a lock, raising if not registered.

Q29.summary: Finds the last kwargs/hash argument in a call, replaces (or drops) pairs whose symbol key matches via the block, removing the hash if empty, and returns the updated call.

Q30.summary: Prints per-cop offense counts sorted by count with correctability info and links, then the total and offending file count.

Q31.summary: Forks a worker that overlays the mutant into its file and runs tests until one fails, then in the parent waits with a deadline and converts the worker's output/exit into a verdict.

Q32.summary: Expands source path patterns minus excludes (warning on unused excludes, raising if empty), optionally filtered to files in the changed set.

Q33.summary: Removes the given number of characters immediately before a node/range after validating it belongs to the corrector's buffer.

Q34.summary: Parses every project file (memoized) and returns the paths whose parse failed.

Q35.summary: For requests with a JSON-compatible content type and non-string body, sets the content-type header and encodes the body with the configured encoder.

Q36.summary: For one statement, records it as dead if it overlaps no live location and is not a kept directive/alias/local, else recurses into its class/block body statements.

Q37.summary: For each registry file, synthesizes mutated source and writes it into outdir, recording it in the manifest, and returns the manifest.

Q38.summary: Prints top-N tables of methods and classes with positive cognitive complexity, noting how many were withheld.

Q39.summary: Requires MFA when needed for the reset, otherwise marks the reset verified if not active, sets the compromised flag and renders the edit form.

Q40.summary: Resolves constant segments to a uniquely registered, owned path by searching lexical nesting, their ancestors (recursively memoized), then top level.

Q41.summary: Returns whether any of the user's GitHub organization teams has the given slug.

Q42.summary: Clears the progress surface if the tally isn't complete, otherwise commits it.

Q43.summary: Loads the config file given by --config (raising if missing) or the default one, normalizing scalars/lists and validated ignore rules plus baseline ignores.

Q44.summary: Issues or uses a confirmation token and sends the confirmation email to the target address, logging and skipping when no token is available.

Q45.summary: Yields the source range of each repeated element (grouping escaped octals, skipping interpolations) within regexp character classes.

Q46.summary: Walks the terminal branches of a method body and flags/autocorrects redundant return statements in tail position.

Q47.summary: For url-encoded requests with non-string, non-IO bodies, sets the content type and encodes the body as a query string, then calls the next app.

Q48.summary: Runs git diff since a ref and returns the changed file paths, raising a descriptive error (with shallow-clone hint) on failure.

Q49.summary: Checks that an if's else/elsif keyword aligns with the base if keyword (or given base), autocorrecting, and recurses into elsif chains.

Q50.summary: When paths are given, keeps only findings whose cited sites match a requested path that lies within project directories.

Q51.summary: Returns true for a blockless call that is a no-arg reader or literal-keyed lookup, not chained off another call, and not a clock/time call.

Q52.summary: For each file with collected words, groups files by shared words via RollCall and turns each group into a finding naming the first package and listing files.

Q53.summary: Runs the block with a parallel manager (given, existing or adapter default), executing or running queued requests, and restores the previous manager afterwards.

Q54.summary: Verifies the WebAuthn credential and either renders an error for failures/blocked users or signs the user in with tracking, flash and redirect.

Q55.summary: Returns true if the call's receiver chain originates from a request-like method call, following local variable assignments without cycles.

Q56.summary: Globs Ruby files from patterns and includes (directories recursively), removes excluded files/patterns, and returns them sorted unique.

Q57.summary: Flags and removes escapes in a regexp that are unnecessary, given whether they're inside a character class, delimiters and allowed metachar escapes.

Q58.summary: Returns sorted [from, to, weight] triples for each dependency edge, weight being the count of evidence for that edge.

Q59.summary: Flushes queued cop enrollments into the registry indices and checks whether the name is a known department.

Q60.summary: Parses argv; for non-help modes layers config-file directories and only those config flags that still parse successfully onto the args and reparses.
